articles.title: Pix vai filtrar ofensas e facilitar retorno de dinheiro enviado por engano
articles.text:
Pix vai filtrar ofensas e facilitar retorno de dinheiro enviado por engano
Medidas fazem parte de um pacote de novidades que o Banco Central pretende implementa no Pix em 2027.
O Banco Central prepara mudanças no Pix para o próximo ano. As novidades incluem bloqueio de mensagens abusivas e recuperação de envios errados.
A autoridade monetária anunciou recursos inéditos para aumentar a segurança das transferências. O pacote prevê análise de risco em tempo real e gestão ativa de chaves.
Novas medidas também incluirão incentivos ao uso do Pix Automático e avanços nos estudos de integração do Pix com o TIPS, da Europa.
O Banco Central anunciou a preparação de mudanças em algumas funcionalidades do Pix a serem implementadas no decorrer de 2027. Uma delas será o combate a conteúdo ofensivo ou ameaçador nas mensagens enviadas junto ao Pix. Outra é a criação de um mecanismo que facilita a recuperação de dinheiro transferido via Pix por engano.
Sobre o primeiro aspecto, as mensagens do Pix consistem em um pequeno texto que o emissor da transferência pode acrescentar à operação para ser lido pelo recebedor.
Elas são úteis para que você possa descrever o motivo daquele pagamento, por exemplo, embora nem todas as instituições financeiras ofereçam essa funcionalidade.
O Banco Central já detectou o uso dessas mensagens para envio de ofensas, ameaças ou intimidações, por isso, prevê criar campanhas educativas sobre o assunto e, principalmente, implementar uma ferramenta que detecta e oculta mensagens inapropriadas.
O Banco Central também pretende criar um mecanismo para que o próprio cidadão que envia um Pix por engano recupere esse dinheiro. Só não está claro como a ferramenta irá funcionar, mas certamente ela será bem-vinda, afinal, a devolução de transferências via Pix, hoje, depende de um contato com banco ou de que o destinatário execute o procedimento.
Vale lembrar que o Pix já conta com o Mecanismo Especial de Devolução (MED), mas essa ferramenta é direcionada à recuperação de valores em caso de fraude ou golpes.
Falando em fraudes, o Banco Central também pretende reforçar a segurança do Pix em 2027. Para tanto, uma série de medidas serão tomadas, sendo a mais notável a criação de um mecanismo que calcula o risco de fraude de cada transação, em tempo real.
As informações obtidas serão compartilhadas com as instituições financeiras, de modo que elas possam autorizar ou não a conclusão de determinadas transações via Pix.
Outras novidades para o Pix previstas para 2027 incluem:
- aprimoramento do Pix Automático e criação de incentivos ao uso dessa modalidade;
- presença mais ativa do Banco Central na gestão de chaves Pix;
- definição de critérios mínimos para o bloqueio preventivo de transações via Pix;
- avanços dos estudos para integração do Pix ao TIPS, sistema de pagamentos instantâneos do Banco Central Europeu.
Observe que o Banco Central não divulgou datas específicas para a implementação desses recursos, apenas sinalizou que eles estão previstos para 2027.
Em 2027, o foco do BC é dar continuidade à agenda evolutiva com o aprimoramento de serviços e o reforço da segurança, garantindo que o Pix siga como uma ferramenta inovadora, eficiente e segura para todos os cidadãos.
Breno Lobo, Coordenador do Fórum Pix

articles.title: Intrusion chez l'hébergeur français LWS, surveillez vos emails
articles.text:
Une intrusion chez l’hébergeur LWS a pu exposer les coordonnées de titulaires de noms de domaine. L'hébergeur français appelle ses clients à la prudence.
Le 16 novembre, LWS a repéré un accès non autorisé au serveur de son service whois, l’annuaire des propriétaires de noms de domaine. Dans un email à ses clients, l’entreprise explique avoir mis fin à l’incident dès son identification, pris des mesures de sécurité et prévenu la CNIL, l’autorité française chargée de protéger les données personnelles.
Données exposées, faux messages : les réflexes à adopter
Plusieurs de vos informations ont pu être copiées et notamment votre nom ou celui de votre organisation, votre adresse postale, votre numéro de téléphone, votre e-mail de contact, vos noms de domaine et votre numéro de compte client. En temps normal, le whois public affiche obligatoirement les coordonnées des entreprises. Celles des particuliers y apparaissent masquées, selon le réglage choisi. LWS prévient toutefois que même les informations masquées ont pu être récupérées.
D’après l’hébergeur, aucune donnée bancaire n’est dans le lot. Les mots de passe, l’espace client et les services ne sont pas touchés non plus, et vous n’avez rien à faire sur votre compte. Mais il y a quand même une exception, en particulier si l’un de vos messages au support contenait un mot de passe ou des données bancaires, mieux vaut donc modifier ce mot de passe et suivre de près vos relevés.
Attention aussi aux arnaques. Il devient désormais plus facile pour un hacker d’envoyer un message bien renseigné sur vous ou vos domaines. Autant dire qu’on se méfiera davantage des demandes inhabituelles de paiement, de renouvellement ou de transfert d’un nom de domaine. Avant de régler une facture ou de cliquer sur un lien envoyé par e-mail, passez par votre espace client pour vérifier. Enfin, LWS assure ne jamais réclamer de mot de passe ou de données de paiement par e-mail, par SMS ou au téléphone.
L’entreprise ne précise pas combien de personnes sont touchées, comment l’intrusion s’est produite ni quand elle a commencé. LWS indique avoir renforcé la sécurité de ses systèmes. Rappelons qu’en mai une faille critique de cPanel, exploitée depuis février, concernait notamment les offres LWS.

articles.title: Penguin Revives Retired DDR4 for AI Servers
articles.text:
With DDR5 DRAM prices high and supply tight, Penguin Solutions is collaborating with Marvell to put DDR4 sitting in retired servers back to work.
Penguin’s eight-DIMM DDR4 Compute Express Link (CXL) add-in card uses Marvell’s Structera X controller to make qualified memory available as additional system capacity on compatible servers. The approach supplements server memory rather than requiring organizations to rely exclusively on DDR5 for expansion.
In a briefing with EE Times, Andy Mills, Penguin’s VP of advanced product development, said enterprises are looking to expand memory capacity while facing procurement and budget pressures. DDR4 recovered during server refreshes cannot go directly into DDR5 memory slots, he said, but Penguin’s approach can connect that older memory through a PCIe expansion card instead.
Penguin is launching the card as AI data centers take a growing share of DRAM. Mills said reusing DDR4 has been talked about for years, but the market shifted quickly, “once DDR5 prices went through the roof.”
The card targets applications that need more memory than a server’s DDR5 slots can accommodate, including EDA, graph workloads, and AI, Mills said. Penguin has also identified AI inference and in-memory databases as potential uses. The aim is to supplement server memory with reclaimed capacity rather than require customers to discard usable DDR4 during a platform transition.
The full-height, half-length card uses a PCIe 5.0 x16 interface and supports CXL 2.0 Type 3. It takes up two slot widths because the DIMMs stand upright on the board. Penguin’s example configuration is 512 GB using eight 64-GB RDIMMs. Mills said some configurations could reach up to 1 TB on a dual-width PCIe add-in card.
Mills said inline compression could increase effective capacity for compressible workloads, potentially allowing a given amount of physical DDR4 to hold twice as much data. The benefit depends on the data and does not increase the amount of installed DRAM. “Obviously, you can’t do that on all data types, but most data types can at least get some benefit from compression.”
The hardware is only part of the offering, Mills said. Penguin pairs the card with a program to recover DDR4 during technology refreshes or source it through resellers. The company said its Zefr screening process subjects reused memory to demanding test conditions. Customer-owned DIMMs are inspected, tested, and qualified before installation, and each populated card is validated in a compatible host system before shipment.
He said that convenience is what customers are responding to. “There’s no way they’re going to take it, retest it themselves, install it in these cards, and then put it back in. That’s too much hassle.”
It’s unclear how much discarded DDR4 can be reused. Mills said not every module will qualify. The memory Penguin is seeing is typically four or five years old, and the company has seen “hundreds of thousands” of RDIMMs and LRDIMMs, mostly from enterprises. “We’ll have better data for you in about six months’ time from now when we burn our first couple of thousand through,” he said.
Hyperscalers have been reclaiming memory for years, Mills said, but enterprises have not. “Enterprise is lagging behind that by several years. That’s the base that we’re targeting with this, and hopefully some hyperscalers along the way as well.
Meta, the parent of Facebook, is already doing this at scale, running CXL-based memory expansion across millions of servers with DDR4 pulled from decommissioned machines, with a controller it designed in-house.

articles.title: Linux Mint 27 Goes Wayland, Overhauls System Apps, and Officially Fixes Hibernation
articles.text:
Friday, November 27th 2026
Linux Mint 27 Goes Wayland, Overhauls System Apps, and Officially Fixes Hibernation
Linux Mint, the beginner-friendly Linux distribution based on Ubuntu, has officially been updated to version 27 in its beta branch. Linux Mint 27 is stacking up to be a rather substantial update, bringing with it a handful of new default system apps, and new UI features in its Cinnamon desktop environment. The biggest functional changes come by way of the Cinnamon 6.8 update, which fully implements Wayland—with support for HiDPI, 3D acceleration, fractional scaling, different keyboard layouts, and touchscreen and touchpad gestures—and gets a few neat UI and usability upgrades. Linux Mint 27 is an LTS update that will be supported until 2031. 
Cinnamon 6.8 also adds a new screensaver and lock screen for both Wayland and X11, a switch to 1:1 touch gestures, and a new screenshot tool—with options to capture: windows with and without shadows, the entire desktop, the current monitor, or a custom selection—rewritten entirely for the Cinnamon desktop. The Nemo file explorer has received a new preview pane that can be enabled and disabled with a UI toggle or by pressing F7, and it now supports Interactive Search for easy document and file searching. Mint 27 also adds a new clock and calendar app with integrations for local calendars, Google Calendar, and CalDAV services. It allows for event creation and online syncing, and it supports toast notification reminders and alarms.The System Administration utility has also been rewritten to include features like environmental variables and kernel management. Linux Mint 27 beta also officially reintroduces hibernation to the desktop environment after it was previously removed upstream by Ubuntu, a change that was previously confirmed in another development update. Mint also has a new terminal emulator called Velocitty, which is based on Ghostty and features comprehensive theming, support for tabs, and session saving. Additionally, Linux Mint introduces Superlight, which is a new system monitor featuring proper monitoring of the CPU, memory, swap, network activity, disc stats, fan speeds, and battery usage and other stats.There is also a new default archive manager, called Unfold, with 7-Zip and RAR support, and a new e-book reader called Xepub. Thingy is another nice new built-in desktop library that allows you to easily access recent files, folders, and favorites, effectively making it easier to pick up where you left off without resorting to desktop session restore.

articles.title: U.S. MATCH Act Puts Semiconductor Inspection in Focus- EE Times
articles.text:
Printing an advanced transistor and manufacturing a commercially viable chip are two very different achievements. The distinction deserves greater attention in Washington’s semiconductor export control debate.
On Nov. 25, Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen confirmed during a visit to Beijing that his government was working to prevent the passage of the proposed U.S. MATCH Act. While the immediate dispute centers on ASML and immersion deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography, the legislation raises a broader question: How much of China’s manufacturing capability depends on foreign equipment that measures and controls production rather than creates semiconductor structures?
As transistor architectures and advanced packaging become more complex, the answer increasingly lies in metrology and inspection.
The economics of yield
Gate-all-around (GAA) transistors require precise control of nanosheet dimensions, epitaxial layer thickness, and material composition. Small variations can affect threshold voltage, carrier mobility, and device performance. Advanced packaging introduces additional challenges, particularly in surface preparation, bonding alignment, and interconnect integrity.
Consider a simplified assembly containing eight known-good dies and requiring seven bonding operations. Assuming independent bonding outcomes, a 99% yield per operation produces a cumulative bonding yield of approximately 93%. At 97%, it falls to 81%, even before accounting for other manufacturing losses.
A defect introduced during final assembly can compromise several functional dies and the manufacturing value accumulated across multiple processing stages. Detecting defects before bonding becomes increasingly valuable as the number and cost of dies within a package rise. This makes process-control equipment a strategic manufacturing asset alongside lithography.
The physics behind process control
Two Israeli equipment manufacturers, Nova and Camtek, illustrate how these capabilities are distributed across the global semiconductor ecosystem.
Nova’s Metrion platform, adopted by leading logic and memory manufacturers for GAA and advanced DRAM applications, uses secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS). An ion beam removes material from a sample, and the resulting secondary ions are analyzed to characterize composition at different depths.
Conventional optical dimensional measurements can characterize geometry, but advanced transistor structures also require information about elemental composition and material interfaces beneath the surface. Integrating SIMS into production environments helps manufacturers identify material variations before they translate into electrical performance problems.
Camtek addresses a different manufacturing constraint. Its Hawk platform supports inspection and three-dimensional metrology for advanced packaging, including wafers containing more than 500 million bumps at pitches below 10 micrometers.
Higher optical resolution typically narrows the field of view in a given imaging configuration, increasing the number of images required to inspect a wafer. Three-dimensional measurements introduce the additional challenge of reconstructing surface topography to identify height variations and planarity issues. Manufacturers must balance sensitivity, measurement accuracy, and throughput. An inspection system that cannot keep pace with production becomes a capacity constraint, regardless of its laboratory performance.
Washington’s 150-day clock
The Senate version of the MATCH Act, S.4281, establishes a mechanism for identifying critical manufacturing equipment and coordinating restrictions with allied supplier countries.
Within 150 days of enactment, the Commerce Department would be required to issue regulations and assess whether allied suppliers’ governments had adopted equivalent controls. Subject to the bill’s waiver provisions, failed diplomatic efforts could trigger unilateral U.S. restrictions on covered foreign equipment through expanded foreign direct product rules.
For Israel, the implications are tangible. If Israeli export controls fall short of the proposed requirements, Washington could extend its jurisdiction to qualifying foreign-produced equipment. Israeli suppliers such as Nova and Camtek would then face potential licensing restrictions based on equipment classification, technology provenance, customer identity, and end use.
Camtek generated approximately 49% of its 2025 revenue from China. The figure underscores how deeply international process-control suppliers are commercially intertwined with China’s semiconductor expansion.
The bill’s annual review mechanism adds another dimension: Equipment categories that escape restrictions today could come under scrutiny as manufacturing technologies evolve.
Controlling installed capacity
Perhaps the most consequential provision concerns servicing.
Semiconductor equipment requires periodic calibration, replacement parts, software maintenance, and application engineering. Introducing new materials or device architectures often requires additional measurement recipes and qualification work.
Inspection algorithms must also adapt to changing defect characteristics, surface reflectivity, and structural complexity. Restrictions on technical support could consequently affect equipment utilization and the qualification of new processes, even where manufacturers already possess the necessary hardware.
Restricting new shipments limits capacity expansion. Restricting support can undermine the productivity of capital already deployed.
China’s learning opportunity
The policy dilemma is particularly acute in inspection and metrology, where competitive advantage depends partly on accumulated production experience.
Chinese equipment developers such as Skyverse need sophisticated optics, precision motion systems, and advanced algorithms. They also need exposure to real manufacturing variability, representative defect populations, and feedback from production engineers.
If export restrictions encourage Chinese manufacturers such as SMIC and CXMT to qualify domestic equipment more extensively, local suppliers could gain access to precisely the environments required to improve measurement repeatability, defect classification, and equipment reliability. Each qualification cycle creates opportunities to refine hardware, software, and process recipes. Access to live production lines is itself a competitive asset.
Washington must weigh the immediate benefits of restricting established process-control technologies against the possibility of accelerating the development of competing Chinese platforms.
In inspection and metrology, restricting equipment exports may buy Washington time. But giving Chinese fabs a stronger incentive to train domestic equipment suppliers on live production lines could substantially shorten the time it actually gains.

articles.title: WhatsApp prueba en el iPhone una barra inferior sin los nombres de las pestañas
articles.text:
WhatsApp comenzó a probar en iPhone una barra de navegación inferior sin los nombres de las pestañas. Los iconos de Novedades, Llamadas, Contactos, Chats y Tú se mantienen, pero el texto que aparecía debajo de cada uno desapareció, según informó el sitio especializado WABetaInfo.
El cambio llegó con la versión beta 26.46.10.71 para iOS, que se distribuye a través de TestFlight, el servicio de Apple para probar aplicaciones antes de su lanzamiento oficial. No está en la versión que descarga el público general desde la tienda App Store.
Según WABetaInfo, la función está disponible solo para algunos de los probadores de la beta y llegará a más personas de forma gradual en las próximas semanas. Por eso, no todos los usuarios de la versión de prueba verán el nuevo diseño de inmediato.
WhatsApp no anunció cuándo lo habilitará para todos los usuarios de iPhone. El medio italiano Telefonino también señaló que no hay fecha de distribución general ni confirmación de que el cambio llegue a la versión estable de la aplicación.
Una barra más baja y con más espacio para el contenido
Al quitar el texto, los iconos ya no tienen que subir para dejar lugar a las etiquetas. La barra ocupa menos altura en la parte inferior de la pantalla y ese espacio queda disponible para el contenido, explicó WABetaInfo.
El sitio sostiene que los iconos son lo bastante reconocibles para identificar cada sección sin necesidad de leer su nombre. Esa es la justificación que ofrece la publicación; WhatsApp no difundió una explicación propia del cambio.
El resultado se parece al de Threads, la red social de Meta, en iOS. También se acerca a la versión de WhatsApp para iPad, donde las etiquetas no se muestran, según WABetaInfo. En el iPhone, hasta ahora, el texto se mantenía junto a cada icono.
Asimismo, diferentes medios especializados han señalado que la barra conserva los mismos iconos y el mismo aspecto, pero sin el texto que los acompañaba, y por eso ocupa menos altura en la parte baja de la pantalla.
El antecedente: el diseño translúcido de iOS 26
WABetaInfo recordó que WhatsApp ya había actualizado la barra en iPhone cuando adoptó la interfaz llamada Liquid Glass, el estilo translúcido, similar al vidrio, que Apple introdujo con iOS 26. Aquel rediseño no eliminó las etiquetas de texto.
La nueva modificación se limita a ese ajuste menor sobre el diseño existente. El portal la describe como un refinamiento que mantiene la apariencia actual de la barra y la hace más compacta, más moderna y compatible con Liquid Glass.
En Android el rediseño es más amplio
En la aplicación para Android, WhatsApp introdujo antes un cambio más profundo, según el mismo sitio: una barra de navegación inferior que flota sobre la pantalla y toma el color de acento del tema de la aplicación.
Esa barra se reduce de tamaño de forma dinámica mientras el usuario se desplaza por la interfaz, y además incorpora un efecto de desvanecimiento progresivo. La versión de iPhone, en cambio, conserva la estructura y solo pierde el texto.
Quienes usan la versión estable en iPhone no verán modificaciones por ahora. WhatsApp no informó cuándo el diseño sin etiquetas llegará a esa versión ni si lo hará en todos los países al mismo tiempo.

articles.title: Efficace sur le lavage, cet aspirateur robot Dreame noté 4,5/5 s'affiche à 418 €
articles.text:
Top produit : L'aspirateur robot Dreame L40s Pro Ultra à 418,00 €
Actuellement noté 4,5/5 par notre rédaction, l'aspirateur robot Dreame L40s Pro Ultra assure d'excellentes performances d'aspiration tout en franchissant des obstacles jusqu'à 4 cm. Il est affiché à 418,00 € chez Electro Depot.
Dreame fait évoluer sa gamme avec le Dreame L40s Pro Ultra, un aspirateur robot conçu pour nettoyer les sols en profondeur tout en gérant les intérieurs complexes. Ce modèle gagne une brosse double anti-nœuds, davantage de puissance et un système revu pour franchir les seuils de portes. L'appareil s'est distingué lors de son passage dans notre labo grâce à son autonomie de fonctionnement.
Le robot descend à 418,00 € chez Electro Depot, soit environ 0 % de moins que le prix moyen constaté ces 30 derniers jours. Cela représente une économie de 0,00 €.
Une aspiration puissante et un lavage automatisé des sols
Le Dreame L40s Pro Ultra combine une forte puissance d'aspiration avec un système de patins rotatifs pour décoller les taches tenaces sur tous types de sols. Comme détaillé dans notre test complet, l'appareil prend en charge l'installation et le retrait automatiques de ses serpillières pour éviter de mouiller les tapis lors des cycles de nettoyage. Sa station d'accueil assure la vidange automatique du collecteur de 0,3 l et lave directement les serpillières après chaque passage, ce qui réduit considérablement les interventions manuelles.
Dreame L40s Pro Ultra
Points forts
- Excellentes performances d’aspiration.
- Fonction de lavage efficace.
- Installation et retrait automatiques des serpillières.
- Traitement des coins amélioré.
- Entretien simplifié.
- Autonomie longue durée et charge rapide.
- App très riche.
- Franchissement d’obstacles jusqu’à 4 cm.
Points faibles
- Autonomie en baisse par rapport au L40 Ultra.
Une navigation tout-terrain sous la barre des 10 cm
Avec une hauteur de 9,7 cm, cet aspirateur robot se glisse sans encombre sous la majorité des meubles bas et des lits. Il se démarque également par sa capacité à franchir des obstacles jusqu'à 4 cm de haut, franchissant ainsi aisément les seuils de portes épais ou les barres de jonction entre deux pièces. Seul bémol relevé par le laboratoire : son autonomie est en baisse par rapport au L40 Ultra, ce qui nécessitera des retours à la base plus fréquents dans les très grands logements, sans que cela ne perturbe le nettoyage des surfaces moyennes.
Mova P50 Pro Ultra : l'autre option face au Dreame L40s Pro Ultra
Le Mova P50 Pro Ultra mise sur une aspiration silencieuse, une brosse latérale extensible efficace pour border les murs et une application mobile très simple à paramétrer. En face, le Dreame L40s Pro Ultra va plus loin sur le lavage des sols grâce à son système d'installation automatique des patins et son entretien de station plus abouti. Le Mova souffre par ailleurs d'un système de filtration qui exige des nettoyages fréquents pour conserver ses performances dans le temps.
Le Mova P50 Pro Ultra coûte 49,02 € de moins que le Dreame L40s Pro Ultra, mais le modèle de Dreame justifie cet écart par sa note actuelle de 4,5/5 contre 4/5 pour son rival et une partie lavage nettement supérieure.
Mova P50 Pro Ultra
Points forts
- Très bonnes performances d’aspiration, surtout sur sols durs et moquette fine.
- Détecte très bien les petits et gros obstacles.
- Passe sur les tapis sans souci.
- Enlève automatiquement ses serpillères selon la nature du sol à nettoyer.
- Très bonne couverture des surfaces.
Points faibles
- Emplacement pour sac à poussière peu pratique.
- Station qui se salit assez vite.
- Système de filtration peu efficace.
- Performances de lavage faibles.

articles.title: Fnac et Darty jouent les prolongations du Black Friday : 15 offres à saisir avant lundi, jusqu'à -55 %
articles.text:
Téléviseurs Mini LED, aspirateurs Dyson et Roborock, enceinte JBL : chez la Fnac et Darty, les prix obtenus pendant le Black Friday n’ont pas bougé ce samedi 28 novembre, et les deux enseignes du groupe affichent toujours les mêmes offres. Nous avons retenu 15 produits, en commençant par ceux que notre rédaction a testés, à partir des prix que Fnac Darty annonce jusqu’au 30 novembre.
Cette sélection s’ouvre sur les trois produits que nous avons testés, puis trois dont nous avons testé un modèle proche, avant les neuf que nous n’avons pas eus en main. Elle couvre les téléviseurs, les aspirateurs robots et balais, l’audio et l’informatique, avec des remises de 27 % à 55 % sur le prix de référence. La plus forte économie en euros revient au Roborock Saros 20X, 690 € de moins, la plus forte en pourcentage à l’aspirateur laveur Roborock F25 Gen2, à -55 %.
- TV TCL 55C89L Mini LED (2026) à 799,99 € au lieu de 1 099 € (-27 %)
- Enceinte JBL Xtreme 4 à 179,99 € au lieu de 329,99 € (-39 %)
- Aspirateur balai Dyson V15 Detect Absolute à 469 € au lieu de 799 € (-31 %)
- Roborock Saros 20X à 778,99 € au lieu de 1 489 € (-46 %)
- Barre de son Bose Smart Soundbar à 329,99 € au lieu de 549,99 € (-40 %)
- TV Hisense 65U7S Pro Mini LED (2026) à 899,99 € au lieu de 1 299 € (-30 %)
- Roborock Qrevo S ProX à 298,99 € au lieu de 599,99 € (-50 %)
- Dreame L10s Ultra Gen3 Set à 328,99 € au lieu de 499,99 € (-34 %)
- Aspirateur balai Dyson V8 Cyclone (2026) à 249 € au lieu de 399 € (-30 %)
- Aspirateur balai Dyson V10 Konical à 349 € au lieu de 499 € (-30 %)
- Aspirateur laveur Roborock F25 Gen2 à 179,99 € au lieu de 399,99 € (-55 %)
- TV TCL 85C69K Pro (2026) à 1 169 € au lieu de 1 899 € (-36 %)
- TV Hisense 75UR9S RGB (2026) à 1 399 € au lieu de 1 999 € (-30 %)
- Écran Lenovo Legion 27Q-10 OLED à 329,99 € au lieu de 479,99 € (-31 %)
- Tablette Lenovo Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 à 399,99 € au lieu de 579,99 € (-31 %)
TCL 55C89L : le Mini LED noté 8/10 dans notre test reste à 799,99 €
Notre test du TCL C8L (C89L) lui a attribué 8/10 sur sa version de 65 pouces, avec près de 3 000 cd/m² mesurés en pointe, un espace DCI-P3 presque entièrement couvert et un blooming bien maîtrisé face à l’écran. Cette version de 55 pouces reprend la même gamme 2026.
✅ Points forts
- Une luminosité spectaculaire : idéale en pièce lumineuse et pour les contenus HDR, selon notre test.
- Taillé pour le jeu : une dalle 144 Hz et de très bonnes prestations gaming.
- À savoir : Fnac Darty annonce aussi une offre de remboursement de 50 €, à réclamer après l’achat. Notre test juge la calibration SDR perfectible.
JBL Xtreme 4 : l’enceinte increvable notée 8/10, à 199,99 €
Notre test de la JBL Xtreme 4 lui a attribué 8/10. Cette enceinte costaude, certifiée IP67, développe une puissance remarquable et une autonomie jugée stupéfiante face à la Xtreme 3 comme à la concurrence. Sa batterie est remplaçable.
✅ Points forts
- Une autonomie gargantuesque : le point fort mis en avant par notre test.
- Robuste : certifiée IP67, avec une batterie remplaçable.
- À savoir : elle perd l’entrée ligne et reste plutôt lourde pour les voyages.
Dyson V15 Detect Absolute : le balai au laser noté 8/10 perd 250 €, à 549 €
Notre test du Dyson V15 Detect Absolute lui a attribué 8/10. Il aspire avec une puissance élevée sur tous les types de sols, filtre l’air avec une grande efficacité et révèle les fines particules grâce à sa brosse laser. Ses brosses se démêlent seules, et il est livré avec de nombreux accessoires.
✅ Points forts
- La brosse laser : elle rend visibles les poussières fines sur les sols durs.
- Des brosses auto-démêlantes : les cheveux ne s’enroulent pas, selon notre test.
- À savoir : il est un peu lourd pour les longues séances, et le mode Boost vide vite la batterie. Fnac Darty annonce cette offre jusqu’au 6 décembre.
Roborock Saros 20X : 690 € de moins sur ce cousin du Saros 20, à 799 €
Le Saros 20X aspire avec 36 000 Pa et lave avec deux serpillières rotatives, pour une hauteur de seulement 7,98 cm et 3 heures d’autonomie annoncées. Nous ne l’avons pas testé, mais notre test du Roborock Saros 20 a attribué 9/10 et notre Prix d’excellence au modèle de base, salué pour son aspiration et sa navigation d’une précision chirurgicale.
✅ Points forts
- 36 000 Pa : la puissance d’aspiration de la gamme Saros 20.
- Très fin : 7,98 cm pour passer sous les canapés et les lits.
- À savoir : notre test du Saros 20 lui reprochait de manquer de punch sur les traces incrustées.
Bose Smart Soundbar : la barre de son Dolby Atmos perd 220 €, à 329,99 €
Cette barre de son compacte réunit cinq haut-parleurs, dont deux orientés vers le plafond pour le Dolby Atmos, et la technologie TrueSpace qui spatialise les contenus stéréo. Elle diffuse en AirPlay 2, Chromecast et Spotify Connect. Nous ne l’avons pas testée, mais notre test de la Smart Soundbar 600, sa devancière, avait attribué 7/10 à ce modèle pour la largeur de sa scène sonore et la précision des dialogues.
✅ Points forts
- Le Dolby Atmos : deux haut-parleurs orientés vers le haut.
- Un mode dialogue par IA : pour mieux entendre les voix, selon Bose.
- À savoir : notre test de la 600 relevait une projection quasi inexistante vers l’arrière de la pièce.
Hisense 65U7S Pro : un Mini LED 165 Hz natifs, à 899,99 €
Ce téléviseur Mini LED de 65 pouces monte à 165 Hz natifs en mode jeu, adopte un traitement anti-reflets, un son 2.1.2 et la certification IMAX Enhanced. Nous ne l’avons pas testé, mais notre test du Hisense U7Q, la génération précédente, avait attribué 7/10 à ce modèle pour son contraste élevé et son calibrage soigné.
✅ Points forts
- 165 Hz natifs : une fluidité taillée pour les consoles et le PC.
- Anti-reflets : pour une pièce lumineuse.
- À savoir : notre test du U7Q regrettait un rétroéclairage Mini LED peu dense ; cette version Pro n’a pas été mesurée.
Roborock Qrevo S ProX : un robot laveur à moitié prix, à 299,99 €
Ce Qrevo S ProX aspire avec 18 500 Pa, lave avec deux serpillières rotatives et tient 3 heures. Haut de 9,65 cm, il reste discret, jusqu’à 59 dB. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- Discret : jusqu’à 59 dB, selon la fiche du modèle.
- Un grand bac : 330 mL de poussière dans le robot.
- À savoir : l’image illustre le Qrevo S Pro, modèle proche.
Dreame L10s Ultra Gen3 : 25 000 Pa et une brosse en caoutchouc, à 329,99 €
Le L10s Ultra Gen3 aspire avec 25 000 Pa grâce à une brosse principale en caoutchouc, adaptée aux cheveux et aux poils d’animaux, et lave avec deux serpillières rotatives. Il tient 3 heures et mesure 9,7 cm de haut. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- 25 000 Pa : pour les sols durs comme les tapis.
- Spécial animaux : une brosse en caoutchouc qui limite les enroulements.
- À savoir : son niveau sonore peut monter à 70 dB.
Dyson V8 Cyclone : 60 minutes d’autonomie et une batterie amovible, à 279 €
Le V8 Cyclone annonce 150 AW d’aspiration constante, jusqu’à 60 minutes d’autonomie et une batterie à clipser, interchangeable. Sa brosse Motorbar démêle et aspire directement les poils. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- Batterie interchangeable : une seconde batterie prolonge le ménage.
- Anti-poils : la brosse Motorbar détache et aspire les poils.
- À savoir : il n’a ni laser ni capteur de particules, réservés au V15 de cette sélection.
Dyson V10 Konical : 150 € de moins sur ce balai anti-emmêlement, à 349 €
Le V10 Konical aspire jusqu’à 150 AW, tient une heure et pèse 2,7 kg, avec une brosse motorisée anti-emmêlement adaptée aux poils d’animaux. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- Une heure d’autonomie : selon la fiche du modèle.
- Anti-emmêlement : une brosse motorisée pensée pour les poils.
- À savoir : il annonce la même puissance maximale que le V8 Cyclone de cette sélection, 70 € moins cher.
Roborock F25 Gen2 : l’aspirateur laveur à -55 %, à 179,99 €
Cet aspirateur laveur sans fil aspire et lave en même temps, avec 20 kPa d’aspiration, un réservoir d’eau propre de 870 mL et 60 minutes d’autonomie annoncées. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- La plus forte remise : -55 %, 220 € de moins sur le prix de référence.
- 60 minutes d’autonomie : de quoi laver un grand appartement.
- À savoir : c’est un aspirateur laveur à main, pas un robot.
TCL 85C69K Pro : un Mini LED de 85 pouces à 1 199 €
Ce téléviseur Mini LED de 85 pouces annonce 420 zones de gradation, 1 000 nits, une dalle 144 Hz, le Dolby Atmos et le DTS:X, sous Google TV. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- 85 pouces : 216 cm de diagonale, pour un vrai home-cinéma.
- 144 Hz : pour les consoles et le PC.
- À savoir : Fnac Darty annonce une offre de remboursement de 100 €, à réclamer après l’achat.
Hisense 75UR9S : 600 € de moins sur ce téléviseur RGB de 75 pouces, à 1 399 €
Ce téléviseur RGB de 75 pouces monte à 180 Hz pour le jeu, adopte une dalle anti-reflets et un système audio Dolby Atmos de 90 W, sous Vidaa. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- 180 Hz : le taux le plus élevé des téléviseurs de cette sélection.
- Un son de 90 W : avec le Dolby Atmos.
- À savoir : il tourne sous Vidaa, et non sous Google TV comme les téléviseurs TCL de cette sélection.
Lenovo Legion 27Q-10 OLED : un écran QD-OLED 240 Hz, à 329,99 €
Cet écran gaming de 26,5 pouces associe une dalle QD-OLED à 240 Hz et un temps de réponse de 0,03 ms, avec la compatibilité AMD FreeSync Premium, deux HDMI et un DisplayPort. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- QD-OLED : des noirs profonds et des couleurs éclatantes.
- 240 Hz : pour les jeux compétitifs.
- À savoir : malgré son nom, sa dalle mesure 26,5 pouces.
Lenovo Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 : une tablette de 13 pouces 144 Hz, à 399,99 €
Cette tablette Android de 13 pouces affiche une définition 3,5K à 144 Hz et embarque une puce Qualcomm Snapdragon 8s Gen 4, quatre haut-parleurs JBL compatibles Dolby Atmos et une batterie de 10 200 mAh. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- Un grand écran 144 Hz : 13 pouces en 3,5K.
- Quatre haut-parleurs JBL : avec le Dolby Atmos.
- À savoir : vérifiez la mémoire et le stockage sur la fiche, Lenovo décline ce modèle en plusieurs configurations.
Jusqu’à quand Fnac Darty maintient-elle ces prix ?
Fnac Darty annonce les prix de cette sélection jusqu’au lundi 30 novembre, jour du Cyber Monday, et jusqu’au 6 décembre pour le Dyson V15. Darty propose en plus 10 % de remise sur les téléviseurs dès 1 500 € d’achat jusqu’au 30 novembre. Les autres offres que nous suivons sont réunies sur notre page Black Friday.
Fnac ou Darty : où acheter d’ici au Cyber Monday ?
Les deux enseignes appartiennent au même groupe, et les offres de cette sélection sont annoncées au même prix sur les deux sites : choisissez selon la livraison, le retrait en magasin ou les services proposés. Une offre de remboursement, comme celles des téléviseurs TCL, se réclame après l’achat et ne réduit pas le prix payé en caisse. Pour comparer les téléviseurs, notre test du TCL C8L détaille ce qu’apporte un bon Mini LED.

articles.title: Galaxy Z Fold 8 tem melhor oferta registrada com cupom da Black Friday
articles.text:
Galaxy Z Fold 8 tem melhor oferta registrada com cupom da Black Friday
Galaxy Z Fold 8 (256 GB) com tela flexível, design de passaporte e câmera de 50 MP recebe desconto de 27% na Black Friday 2026, no Pix com cupom exclusivo no Magalu
O Galaxy Z Fold 8 de 256 GB está saindo por R$ 9.249 no Pix com cupom exclusivo BFTECNOBLOG no Magazine Luiza. O novo dobrável da Samsung, com tela AMOLED flexível de 7,6″ e design em formato de passaporte, atinge o menor preço histórico na Black Friday 2026, recebe desconto de 27% sobre o preço de R$ 12.599.
Esta oferta é o menor preço que já encontramos para o Galaxy Z Fold 8 5G 256 GB. Nas outras 4 ofertas publicadas desde outubro de 2026, o melhor foi R$ 9.649,10 (Amazon, 25/11/2026).
O Z Fold 8 é um lançamento recente da Samsung, com design de passaporte e tamanho de tablet pequeno, mas que cabe no bolso quando fechado. Sua tela interna AMOLED Dinâmico 2X flexível de 7,6″ e taxa de 120 Hz tem ótima definição de imagem, e a externa de 5,5″, também de 120 Hz, é compacta e confortável.
Seu chip de ponta Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy e os 12 GB de RAM nem suam ao rodar apps pesados em multitarefa, games exigentes e soluções do Galaxy AI localmente. Os 256 GB de espaço interno são adequados para guardar vídeos e fotos.
O kit de câmeras filma em 4K a 60 fps, com duas lentes principais de 50 MP (wide e ultrawide), além de duas selfies de 10 MP, uma externa wide e uma interna ultrawide.
O corpo de alumínio Advanced Armor com dobradiças de titânio do Z Fold 8 conta com a estrutura Flex Titanium sob a tela interna, que reduz ao máximo o vinco e o deixa quase invisível. O vidro Gorilla Glass 2 protege a tela externa, e a certificação IP48 oferece resistência à água e proteção moderada contra poeira.
A bateria de silício-carbono de 4.800 mAh resiste a até 26 horas de reprodução de vídeo, segundo a Samsung. O suporte ao carregamento rápido com fio de 45 W e sem fio de 20 W (Qi2) garante energia para um dia inteiro.
O Galaxy Z Fold 8 (R$ 9.249 no Pix com cupom exclusivo BFTECNOBLOG) será atualizado até o Android 24 e possui conectividade 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0, Ultra Wideband (UWB) e NFC.

articles.title: Upgrade to Wi-Fi 7 with these stellar deals — TP-Link and Netgear Wi-Fi 7 routers get big Black Friday discounts
articles.text:
Upgrade to Wi-Fi 7 with these stellar deals — TP-Link and Netgear Wi-Fi 7 routers get big Black Friday discounts
We've rounded up several excellent deals on Wi-Fi 7 routers from TP-Link and Netgear
Black Friday Day 2026 is here, and we're already seeing some tasty deals on Wi-Fi routers. If you're in the market for a Wi-Fi 7 router, we've scoped out deals on standalone and mesh systems that could give your home (or office) network a much-needed performance boost.
If you have a smaller home that doesn't need the aid of wireless satellites to improve coverage, consider the TP-Link Archer BE230 Wi-Fi 7 router. While it isn't one of TP-Link's most feature-packed Wi-Fi 7 offerings, it still offers a lot of bang for the buck. The Archer BE230 has a retail price of $119.99, but is currently just $74.99.
That price gets you 2.5 GbE WAN, four Gigabit LAN ports, and even a USB 3.0 port for adding storage to your network. The Archer AXE75 also supports EasyMesh, enabling you to combine multiple compatible routers into a mesh network.
Regarding performance, the Archer AXE75 operates at speeds of up to 688 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz band and up to 2,882 Mbps on the 5 GHz band.
The TP-Link Archer A230 is a value-priced dual-band Wi-Fi 7 router that features three GbE LAN ports and one 2.5 GbE WAN port.

If you need the added coverage of a mesh system, the TP-Link Deco BE63, which is a tri-band Wi-Fi 7 solution offering coverage of up to 5,800 square feet.
Each satellite has four 2.5 GbE ports, which are excellent for connecting your wired-only network devices, along with a single USB 3.0 port. However, there's another added benefit: the Deco BE63 supports wired backhaul, which can improve overall network performance compared to using the default wireless backhaul between satellites.
The Deco BE63 is typically available for $349.99, but is currently on sale for $279.99 for a two-pack.
The Deco BE63 is a mid-range, tri-band Wi-Fi 7 router with four 2.5 GbE ports, 10 Gbps of combined throughput, and coverage of 5,800 square feet.

Finally, on the TP-Link side, there's the Deco BE5000. This is an entry-level Wi-Fi 7 mesh router. Because of this alignment, the Deco BE5000 isn't a full-featured tri-band offering; instead, it's a dual-band Wi-Fi 7 solution. Although you miss out on the higher-performance 6 GHz band, you do gain support for Multi-Link Operation (MLO), a key pillar of Wi-Fi 7 (although MLO is one of Wi-Fi 7's most misunderstood features).
Each node features two 2.5 GbE ports, and you also get wired backhaul support. Maximum throughput reaches 688 Mbps for the 2.4 GHz band, while the 5 GHz band achieves 2,882 Mbps.
The Deco BE5000 retails for $299.99 but is currently priced at $198.19, which is a healthy $100 discount.
The TP-Link Deco BE5000 is a dual-band Wi-Fi 7 router that features three nodes and covers up to 6,600 square feet. Each node features 2.5 GbE ports and supports wired backhaul.

TP-Link isn't the only manufacturer doling out some enticing Wi-Fi 7 router discounts. If you're looking for a mid-range Wi-Fi 7 mesh router, the Netgear Orbi 770 is currently on sale for $424.99, which is sizable discount from its normal $549.99 asking price.
The Orbi 700 Wi-Fi 7 mesh router is designed to envelope a spacious 5,500 square feet of space with peak speeds of up to 11 Gbps. These speedy routers come with three 2.5 GbE LAN ports and a single 2.5 GbE WAN port.

The main router node features three 2.5 GbE LAN ports alongside a dedicated 2.5 GbE WAN port, whereas the satellite node provides two 2.5 GbE ports. Notably, neither unit includes a USB 3.x port, a feature that is becoming standard in this price range.
For wireless performance, the Orbi 770 supports speeds up to 688 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz band, 4,320 Mbps on 5 GHz, and 5,760 Mbps on 6 GHz. It provides coverage for up to 5,550 square feet—well above the average American home size of roughly 2,220 square feet. Network setup and management are available via Netgear's web interface or the Orbi mobile app.
In our review of the three-node Orbi 770 system, we praised its user-friendly setup and generous port selection, though its high retail price remained a drawback. This Black Friday deal directly addresses that main concern.
Netgear's Nighthawk RS90 is a dual-band Wi-Fi 7 router with a sleek exterior (aided by its internal antennas). It also has a full load of GbE and 2.5 GbE ports to support your wired client.

The Netgear Nighthawk RS90 is priced at just $84.79 (15% off). It is a dual-band Wi-Fi 7 router, meaning that they don't include the higher-performance 6 GHz radio. articles.title: No HC relief to Tata Trusts on plea against Chandrasekaran reappointment; Nov 30 board meet on
articles.text:
No HC relief to Tata Trusts on plea against Chandrasekaran reappointment; Nov 30 board meet on
A bench of Justice Abhay Ahuja said any outcome of the meeting shall be subject to final orders of the court.
Declining any urgent relief to the two Tata Trusts that had challenged the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for a third five-year term, the Bombay High Court on Friday said the November 30 board meeting of Tata Sons can be held as scheduled.
A bench of Justice Abhay Ahuja said any outcome of the meeting shall be subject to final orders of the court.
The Tata Trusts had sought for the meeting to be deferred or stayed or for an order that Chandrasekaran would not be allowed to exercise his vote as executive chairman.
During the hearing, the court asked what was the need to defer the meeting or not permit Chandrasekaran to cast his vote as executive chairman when he is already holding the post in his second term.
The court, however, refused to grant any relief to the two Tata Trusts on Friday.
"We are not granting any relief today. Let the meeting (on November 30) go on as per schedule. Any outcome of the meeting would be subject to our final orders," the court said.
The bench ordered Tata Sons and the other respondents in the case, which include the board members, to submit their reply affidavits to two suits filed on Thursday (November 26) and posted the matter for further hearing on January 18, 2027.
The Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) and the RD Tata Trust (RDTT) had filed the suits in the High Court against Tata Sons and six of its directors, challenging the reappointment of Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for a third five-year term.
The SDTT has sought Rs 50 crore, while the RDTT has demanded Rs 15 crore in damages, with 18% annual interest.
As per the suits, the September 17 Tata Sons board resolution reappointing Chandrasekaran was invalid because it did not receive the affirmative vote required under Article 121 of the company's Articles of Association (AoA).
The immediate relief sought was to prevent the chairman of Tata Sons from exercising his casting vote during the November 30 board meeting in the event of a split in opinion among nominee directors.
On Friday, the trusts' counsels also sought for the meeting to be deferred which was opposed by Tata Sons.
"His (Chandrasekaran) third term is not coming into effect on Monday (November 30), right? He is already the chairman executive now. What are the plaintiffs (trusts) anticipating to happen during the November 30 meeting?" Justice Ahuja asked, seeking to know what was the need to defer the meeting or not permit Chandrasekaran to cast his vote.
There may be some other items on the agenda for the November 30 meeting other than confirmation of the reappointment of Chandrasekaran as executive chairman, the court said, adding those matters can be heard and decided.
Senior counsel Harish Salve, appearing for Tata Sons, said the board meeting needs to be held as it has got direction from the Reserve Bank of India giving a deadline of December 12 to inform the RBI of its (Tata Sons) decision (to comply with the mandated listing).
Any resolution passed would be subject to the orders of the high court, Salve said.
Senior counsel Abhishek Manu Singhvi, appearing for the SDTT, said the RBI directive is just a ploy used by Tata Sons to show fake urgency to hold the meeting.
Singhvi sought a deferment of the board sitting on November 30, claiming that it has been called to confirm the minutes of the September 17 meeting during which it was decided to reappoint Chandrasekaran.
He pointed out Article 121 of the Articles of Association, which says such a decision cannot be taken unless there is an affirmative vote of the majority of the trustees.
When Noel Tata, who chairs Tata Trusts, had not given an affirmative voting in the September 17 meeting, then there was no majority and hence the next step of taking the vote of the other four board members could not have been initiated, Singhvi argued.
"Majority between two votes cannot be one vote. It has to be more than one. Noel Tata made it clear on September 17 that there was no affirmative majority vote. When Noel Tata disagreed there was lack of majority vote," Singhvi said.
The senior counsel added that Chandrasekaran's third term would be effective from February 27, 2027.
Singhvi submitted to the court the agenda of the November 30 meeting after which Justice Ahuja noted that one of the items was to confirm Chandrasekaran's reappointment.
Senior counsel Aspi Chinoy, appearing for RDTT, argued that the casting vote confirming the reappointment could not have been cast when there was no affirmative majority vote.
"The (reappointment) decision is perverse. They have destroyed the structure of the Articles that has governed the company for generations," he submitted.
Salve, appearing for Tata Sons, said there can never be a majority vote when there are two nominees for the trust and hence the resolution had to go for a casting vote.
"The decision (to reappoint Chandrasekaran) was taken after a unanimous vote. One of the directors ( Noel Tata) holds the company hostage by saying he won't vote until things are done his way. It cannot be that if Noel Tata says no, it is a no. There could not have been a majority when there are only two directors," Salve contended.
Noel Tata says either it is his way or the highway, Salve argued and questioned as to why the suits were filed in November when the meeting and decision of reappointment were taken two months ago in September.
Salve added that the trusts, in their interim application, have not asked for deferment of the November 30 meeting. No prejudice would be caused if the meeting is held as scheduled.
"The two trustees (SDTT and RDTT) cannot paralyse the company," Salve stated.
The suits said Article 121 of Tata Sons' AoA does not permit the chairman of a board meeting to exercise a casting vote in cases where the articles require the affirmative vote of a majority of the trustees.
The dispute follows Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons executive chairman for five more years at the September 17 board meeting.
The suits have said the decision was "ultra vires the Articles of Association and is invalid, illegal, null and void".
Tata Trusts holds around 66 per cent of Tata Sons and has sought a permanent order and injunction restraining the latter, its directors, officers and other agents from acting upon in any manner or giving effect to the resolution reappointing Chandrasekaran.""

articles.title: Cómo bloquear WhatsApp con contraseña
articles.text:
Bloquear la aplicación de WhatsApp con contraseña agrega una capa de seguridad para proteger el acceso a la plataforma tanto en teléfonos Android como en iPhone.
En Android, el bloqueo de aplicación permite usar la huella dactilar o el reconocimiento facial para desbloquear WhatsApp. Aunque la aplicación permanezca bloqueada, es posible atender llamadas.
Para utilizar esta función, primero es necesario configurar los rasgos biométricos, como la huella dactilar o el reconocimiento facial, en los ajustes del teléfono.
Cómo activar el bloqueo de WhatsApp en Android
En WhatsApp, toca el ícono de más opciones, representado por tres puntos verticales, y sigue esta ruta: Ajustes > Privacidad > Bloqueo de aplicación. Luego, activa la opción “Desbloquear con rasgos biométricos”.
Escanea el rostro para confirmar la configuración. Es posible elegir cuánto tiempo debe transcurrir antes de que la aplicación solicite nuevamente la autenticación y activar la opción “Mostrar contenido en las notificaciones” para ver una vista previa de los mensajes nuevos.
Para desactivar el bloqueo, toca el ícono de más opciones y ve a Ajustes > Privacidad > Bloqueo de aplicación. Después, desactiva “Desbloquear con rasgos biométricos”.
La función está disponible en dispositivos con Android 6.0 o superior que tengan sensor de huella dactilar y sean compatibles con la API de huella dactilar de Google. El reconocimiento facial solo funciona en equipos que cuenten con un escáner para ese fin.
No es compatible con Samsung Galaxy S5, Samsung Galaxy Note 4 ni Samsung Galaxy Note 8. Si la autenticación facial o por huella dactilar falla, WhatsApp puede desbloquearse con el PIN del dispositivo.
Cómo activar el bloqueo en iPhone
En un iPhone, el bloqueo de aplicación de WhatsApp requiere Touch ID o Face ID. Cuando está activado, también permite responder mensajes desde las notificaciones y atender llamadas, aun con la aplicación bloqueada.
Antes de activar esta opción, es necesario configurar Touch ID o Face ID en la sección Configuración del iPhone. Luego, en WhatsApp, abre Configuración y sigue esta ruta: Privacidad > Bloqueo de aplicación. Activa “Requerir Face ID”.
La aplicación puede bloquearse inmediatamente o después de un minuto, 15 minutos o una hora.
Para desactivar la función, abre Ajustes en WhatsApp, toca Privacidad > Bloqueo de aplicación y desactiva “Requerir Face ID”. Si Touch ID o Face ID no desbloquean WhatsApp, se puede ingresar el código del iPhone.
Con qué otras funciones de WhatsApp proteger la app
Además del bloqueo de la aplicación, WhatsApp ofrece otras funciones para proteger la cuenta, los mensajes y la información personal.
Estas herramientas permiten limitar el acceso a conversaciones sensibles, reducir el riesgo de intentos de fraude y elegir qué datos pueden ver otros usuarios.
Una de las principales opciones es la verificación en dos pasos. Esta función añade una contraseña a la cuenta para evitar que otra persona pueda registrarla solo con el código recibido por SMS o llamada.
WhatsApp también permite añadir una dirección de correo electrónico para recuperar el acceso si el usuario olvida esa clave. La plataforma recomienda no compartir ni el código de registro ni la contraseña con terceros.
Otra alternativa es el bloqueo de chats. Esta herramienta oculta conversaciones individuales o grupales dentro de una carpeta protegida por el código del teléfono, la huella dactilar, Face ID o un código secreto.
Además, las notificaciones de esos chats no muestran el nombre del contacto ni el contenido del mensaje.
Para proteger el historial, se pueden activar las copias de seguridad cifradas de extremo a extremo.
Conviene revisar los ajustes de privacidad: desde allí es posible definir quién ve la última conexión, la foto de perfil, los estados y la información personal.
La aplicación incluye una revisión de privacidad guiada, una función para silenciar llamadas de números desconocidos y opciones para bloquear o reportar contactos no deseados.

articles.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong Sea of Sorrow Free DLC Gets December Release Date
articles.text:
Friday, November 27th 2026
Hollow Knight: Silksong Sea of Sorrow Free DLC Gets December Release Date
Hollow Knight: Silksong launched in September 2025 as one of the most highly anticipated indie games in recent memory, and barely two months post-launch, it was confirmed to be getting its first free DLC, Sea of Sorrow. Now, nearly a year later, Team Cherry has officially revealed that Sea of Sorrow will launch on December 11, 2026. In its November 27 Cherry Time announcement, the game studio also gave us a taste of what's to come in the Sea of Sorrow DLC:
In Sea of Sorrow, players will voyage above and beneath Pharloom's forgotten ocean, across islands, through forts and into deep caverns beneath the waves. We've spent the whole year stuffing this adventure full with all the things you'd expect from Hollow Knight: Silksong - crazed characters, high adventure, and epic bosses! It's also overflowing with more exceptional music by the eternally talented Christopher Larkin!
The trailer for Sea of Sorrow follows.Team Cherry also announced the first handful of games to be published under its new Team Cherry Presents publishing label and revealed that it has expanded its formerly three-person team with a fourth member to head up the aforementioned publishing division.

articles.title: Tesla : Elon Musk va devoir attendre jusqu'à 2028 pour la prochaine génération de puces
articles.text:
Les capacités de production pour les puces sont en tension, pour tout le monde. Et même pour un géant de l'envergure de Tesla !
La prochaine génération de puces chez Tesla sera la AI5, un composant qui promet des performances multipliées par cinq par rapport à la génération AI4 - qui pilote les dernières Tesla neuves. Mais si théoriquement la puissance sera au rendez-vous, ledit rendez-vous n'est clairement pas pour tout de suite, d'après les dernières informations qui viennent de tomber !
Le partenaire de Tesla donne la priorité à Microsoft et Google
Tesla n'est pas dans la meilleure des positions aujourd'hui dans le secteur des semi-conducteurs. Si l'on en croit le média taïwanais Commercial Times, dont Wccftech se fait l'écho, le partenaire de Tesla pour la conception de l'AI5, Global Unichip Corporation (GUC), ne donne pas la priorité à Elon Musk.
Ce dernier, qui dispose comme presque tout le monde d'une allocation limitée de la capacité de production de TSMC, va donner la priorité pour l'année 2027 aux puces destinées aux fournisseurs de services cloud. Parmi ceux-ci, la gamme Axiom de Google et les produits Microsoft.
Pas de production de masse en 2027 pour la puce AI5 de Tesla
Et il y a une logique financière évidente pour cet arbitrage de la part de GUC. Les fournisseurs de services cloud offrent en effet une meilleure visibilité sur leurs commandes, et disposent de marges brutes élevées. Résultat, le partenaire de Tesla choisit ici ceux qui offrent le meilleur profil de payeur.
La puce AI5 ne devrait ainsi pas bénéficier d'une expédition de masse durant l'année 2027, et il faudra attrendre l'année suivante (2028) pour que ce soit le cas. Les premières puces devraient par ailleurs d'abord intégrer les robots Optimus de Tesla, et une fois l'expérience de production accumulée, celle-ci pourra commencer à s'orienter vers les véhicules du constructeur.
Source : Wccftech

articles.title: Roku libera nova tela inicial para dispositivos no Brasil
articles.text:
Roku libera nova tela inicial para dispositivos no Brasil
Atualização promete ser a maior feita pela empresa em sua interface nos últimos dez anos.
A Roku anunciou sua nova tela inicial para dispositivos brasileiros. A mudança promete uma navegação mais fluida no sistema, criada a partir de feedbacks dos usuários. Entre as principais novidades estão as recomendações selecionadas com uso de IA e uma reorganização dos apps de streaming, seguindo critérios de popularidade, sugestões personalizadas e tipos de conteúdo disponíveis.
Segundo o diretor de Marketing e Produtos da TPV Brasil, que fabrica TVs com o sistema da Roku, o objetivo é garantir uma “experiência de assistir à TV cada vez mais simples, intuitiva e conectada”. Ele afirma que a atualização deve salvar tempo do usuário na hora de selecionar o que assistir.
A Roku está presente no país em smart TVs de marcas como AOC, TCL, Philco e Multi, com preços a partir de R$ 1.214. A empresa também oferece um dongle em versões Full HD ou 4K, custando ao menos R$ 239,90 no e-commerce nacional.
A atualização traz uma nova interface no menu do sistema operacional, focando em sugestões de inteligência artificial e reorganização dos aplicativos. Há novas seções disponíveis, como “Principais escolhas para você”, que traz recomendações personalizadas, além de “Acesso rápido”, com destaque para apps mais acessados por quem assiste.
Outras novidades também chegam ao sistema, como a parte “Destinos”, que organiza conteúdos de acordo com esilo e gosto dos usuários, e comandos do dia a dia, como melhorias na lupa de busca.
A Roku promete oferecer um sistema fluido e funcional nas TVs e dongles. Eu cheguei a utilizar um modelo de TV Box da Roku e, de fato, essa é uma qualidade interessante. A disposição dos conteúdos e a facilidade com que se encontram serviços em geral entregam um sistema simples, mas funcional.
O update revelado pela Roku segue apostando nessa disposição diferenciada de conteúdos, mas agora com uso de IA para levantar sugestões e reorganizar as primeiras opções de cada usuário. Algumas mudanças pontuais prometem incrementar a experiência, como novos atalhos para conteúdos do dia a dia, como “Minha lista”, “Planos de fundo” e “Temporizador”.
A atualização já está disponível tanto para televisores quanto para os dongles em si.

Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra
Points forts

Points faibles

Une autonomie solide mais une charge qui reste lente
Alimenté par une batterie de 5 000 mAh, ce smartphone assure une autonomie solide pour tenir de longues sessions loin d'une prise. Le stylet S Pen fait l'impasse sur le Bluetooth, une concession qui dérangera uniquement ceux qui utilisaient les fonctions de commande à distance.

Le Galaxy S25 coûte 310,99 € de moins que le Galaxy S25 Ultra au tarif du jour, mais pour les utilisateurs qui cherchent un très grand affichage et une polyvalence photo maximale, le Galaxy S25 Ultra justifie son surcoût.

Points faibles

articles.title: Beijing’s AI ambitions are under threat as models may fall behind by up to nine months versus competitors — Chinese AI labs are under heavy fire from export controls, maturing chip stacks and a distillation crackdown
articles.text:
Beijing’s AI ambitions are under threat as models may fall behind by up to nine months versus competitors — Chinese AI labs are under heavy fire from export controls, maturing chip stacks and a distillation crackdown
The floundering frontier
This week, several reports have detailed how closing GPU rental loopholes across Asia may have had an impact on the development of Chinese AI models. In September, Mozilla estimated that open-weight AI models were three to six months behind the frontier. Since then, developments in the AI industry and export control rules could mean that Chinese AI models, many of which are typically open-weight, might fall even further behind Western counterparts, by up to nine months.
Zhipu AI, the developer of the GLM series of models, has allegedly pushed its release calendar back as a result of reduced access to advanced AI accelerators, Reuters said. It's an open secret that data centers located in Asia have been renting compute capacity to Chinese entities for some time. In light of the recent Nvidia scandal involving Jensen Huang and Megaspeed, the U.S. Department of Commerce has since tightened its rules over how data centers lend their compute capacity to Chinese entities. This has created an environment where there is, in fact, an excess of compute capacity available in the region, Bloomberg reported.
These curbs have a knock-on effect on how companies train their AI models, with Nvidia's AI accelerators being the most coveted; not having access to them stifles the development of AI in the region. However, this isn't entirely true across the industry. DeepSeek is attempting to wean itself off foreign silicon and instead adopting Huawei's Ascend AI chips, and porting its libraries away from CUDA and onto the open-source CANN. However, this hasn't stopped Chinese AI labs from facing another issue: tightened security against the distillation of AI models.
Distillation is a practice wherein the way a model thinks can be extracted and then learned from. It is largely believed to be the method in which Chinese AI labs have made great leaps in intelligence over the past several years, though several of China's leading labs refute that claim. The Western frontier has become more obtuse: Anthropic in October detailed how it's leveled up its own defences against distillation attacks, and the obfuscation of an AI model's chain of thought adds another hurdle. According to The Information, this is an issue that DeepSeek is now reportedly reckoning with. If distillation curbs the development of Chinese AI models even further, the gap between Eastern and Western frontier intelligence grows from three to six months to an estimated nine months.
The current standings
If you look at Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index, which ranks AI models across a wide range of benchmarks and scores them in numerical order, Anthropic currently has the leading public AI model: Claude Fable 5.2, at a total of 65 points. Meanwhile, the leading Chinese AI model, Kimi K3.1 Pro, sits at 47. Between the two contenders are practically every Western frontier lab: OpenAI, Google, and Meta are all outgunning Chinese competitors, which were, just a few short months ago, competing at the frontier across many tasks.
It's important to mention that Artificial Analysis also changed its methodology over recent weeks, with China's AI models falling slightly further behind in added benchmarks, such as the Omniscience score, which tracks how often an AI is likely to hallucinate. This is paired with a jump in capability among the Western labs: Right now, it's on the Chinese AI labs' shoulders to respond in kind, and if current releases are anything to go by, they are falling short of expectations, especially in domains such as cybersecurity. An Epoch AI report characterized the difference in capabilities between GLM 5.3 and Claude Opus 5.5 as a six-to-seven-month gap in intelligence. With the release of newer models like Claude Fable 5.2, it's likely that gap has only widened, and the same story is likely to play out over the next few months across additional domains.
With additional safeguards against distillation and powerful compute resources becoming more difficult to find, this poses a difficult question for the Chinese labs: How can they keep up the pace and stay competitive while the odds are stacked against them?
China still holds the overall top spot in the open-weight arena with Kimi K3.1 Pro, though Western companies are bringing more performant models out as the months pass. China's second tier of open-weight models, which can often be run locally, e.g Alibaba's Qwen 3.8-27B (20 on AA), is facing competition from the American-made Thinking Machines Labs' Inkling 2 Mini (20 on AA), which was recently released. With the release of the larger (closed-weight and API only) Qwen 4 model seemingly not landing quite as well with users, it remains to be seen whether Alibaba can maintain the advantage of time, as Inkling 2 Mini was released just this week, while Qwen 3.8-27B has been out for several months.
With devices like the RTX Spark, AMD's AI Halo, and more, users are increasingly getting their own choice of running an open-weight AI, and for all intents and purposes, that usually means using a Chinese model to get the most intelligence out of your machine. However, recent developments show that smaller Western labs are also beginning to bridge that gap.
This is yet another arena in which Chinese and Western labs will want to wrest control from one another. Notably, Google has not released another series of Gemma models following Gemma 4 back in April. If a fifth generation of Google's Gemma models arrives, they'd likely be close cousins to the Gemini Neon, Carbon, Argon, and Hydrogen family, though that remains speculation until Google confirms anything official.
The silicon transition
Against the backdrop of export controls and tightening restrictions on AI distillation, Chinese AI labs are in a tough spot, and all eyes are on frontier labs like Moonshot AI, Zhipu, Deepseek, Alibaba, and Xiaomi to see if they can scale the intelligence wall that their Western counterparts currently present. More compute for training resources may be an answer, but for comparison's sake, Huawei's upcoming Ascend 950DT accelerator offers 2 PFLOPS of FP4 compute and 1 PFLOPS of FP8, while an Nvidia Rubin R200 offers 50 PFLOPS in inference and 35 PFLOPS in dense workloads. In memory capacity and bandwidth, the Ascend 950DT can offer 144GB of HiZQ 2.0 with 4 TB/s of bandwidth across a 2 TB/s interconnect. Rubin, on the other hand, offers 288GB of HBM4, with bandwidth ranging from 19.2-22 TB/s, across an NvLink interconnect at 2.6 TB/s.
If China's AI ambitions are to compete with the West, its silicon needs to either scale so the country can produce more chips to outgun a Western AI deployment with sheer numbers, or it needs to develop more advanced accelerators, while also managing the CANN software stack. The chips are figuratively, and literally, stacked heavily against China. As the race to develop Artificial Intelligence marches on, the Department of Commerce's latest measures have undoubtedly made it incredibly difficult for the country to compete.
Sayem Ahmed is the Subscription Editor at Tom's Hardware. He covers a broad range of deep dives into hardware, both new and old, including the CPUs, GPUs, and everything else that uses a semiconductor. He has worked as a professional tech journalist since 2015 and has written for Gamespot, IGN, and Dexerto.

Arabic.AI joins UAE government's FedAI ecosystem as founding partner
- UAE-based artificial intelligence company Arabic.AI has been named among the first 17 national and global partners of the UAE Government's National Integrated Agentic AI Ecosystem (FedAI), alongside companies including e&, Microsoft, IBM, Oracle and Google Cloud.
- Founded in 2008 by Nour Al Hassan, Arabic.AI develops Arabic-first AI technologies, including proprietary large language models (LLMs), serving government entities and enterprises across the MENA region.
- FedAI is a unified, sovereign technology platform that enables federal entities to develop and operate AI solutions within secure government infrastructure. As a partner, Arabic.AI will contribute its Arabic-language and sovereign AI capabilities to the ecosystem.
- The initiative forms part of the UAE Government's strategy to integrate agentic AI into 50% of its sectors, services and processes within two years.
Press release:
Arabic.AI has been named one of 17 national and global partners in the first cohort of the UAE Government's National Integrated Agentic AI Ecosystem (FedAI), which was announced in the presence of Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence.
Founded in the UAE in 2008 by Nour Al Hassan, Arabic.AI develops Arabic-first AI technologies, including its own large language models, for government and enterprise clients across the MENA region.
FedAI is a unified, secure and sovereign platform that enables federal entities to build and run AI systems within government infrastructure. Other partners in the first cohort include e&, Microsoft, IBM, Oracle and Google Cloud.
The UAE Government aims for 50% of its sectors, services and processes to run on agentic AI within two years.
Arabic.AI has been named one of 17 national and global partners in the first cohort of the UAE Government's National Integrated Agentic AI Ecosystem (FedAI). The first cohort was announced in the presence of H.H. Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence. Iyad Ahmad, CTO of Arabic.AI, represented the company.
FedAI is a unified, secure and sovereign national technology platform for developing and operating assistive AI solutions. It enables federal entities to build and run AI systems within secure government infrastructure. Through this single ecosystem, the UAE government brings national capabilities and global expertise together, giving government entities flexible and secure access to AI. The government's target is for 50% of its sectors, services and processes to run on agentic AI within two years.
The announcement follows the UAE Cabinet's adoption of FedAI, chaired by H.H. Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President, Prime Minister, and Ruler of Dubai, who said the goal is "for the UAE government to be the fastest, most efficient, and most prepared for the technologies of the future."
As a FedAI partner, Arabic.AI will contribute its sovereign AI capabilities to the ecosystem, supporting government entities that need AI built for their language, their data and their infrastructure.
"It is a privilege to be named among the first cohort of FedAI partners. This milestone reflects what Arabic.AI has been building from day one: AI that understands our region, speaks our language and runs on infrastructure our institutions control. We are honoured to support the UAE Government's vision and look forward to contributing to the ecosystem," said Nour Al Hassan, Founder and CEO of Arabic.AI.

articles.title: Sur deux roues et sans moteur thermique : l’incroyable exploit de ce SUV BYD face à un Boeing 747
articles.text:
En 2006, Volkswagen avait bluffé le monde en tractant un Boeing 747 avec son Touareg. Équipé du très musculeux V10 TDI, le SUV allemand est parvenu à promener le gros porteur de 155 tonnes sur près de 150 mètres à faible vitesse. Monumental à l’époque, le coup de pub demeure encore remarquable aujourd’hui. BYD reproduit ainsi l’exploit avec sa marque Denza désireuse de se faire une place dans le premium automobile.
Son SUV Bao 5 s’est ainsi mis à la tâche dans des conditions presque similaires. Puisque reproduire la même chose n’aurait aucun sens, BYD a tenu à corser les choses avec un Boeing 747-400 plus imposant que le 747-200 utilisé par Volkswagen. La masse de l’engin passe ainsi de 155 à 180 tonnes, ce qui n’est pas rien. Ensuite, le Denza Bao 5 s’est vu imposer un handicap de taille en roulant uniquement sur deux roues !
Deux roues retirées et 1 600 m parcourus : les coulisses d’une image surréaliste
Pour montrer qu’il n’y a pas de triche, BYD a carrément retiré les deux roues du côté droit pour des images surréalistes. Le but était de démontrer les capacités de l’ensemble hybride rechargeable du SUV. Pour accommoder le véhicule, trois essais ont été successivement menés avec une difficulté allant crescendo : le premier sur quatre roues, le deuxième sur trois roues et le troisième sur deux roues.
Au final, le Bao 5 a tracté le Boeing sur près de 1 600 mètres, ce qui surpasse largement la performance établie il y a 20 ans par Volkswagen. Quelques modifications ont néanmoins été faites pour permettre l’exploit. Comme le Touareg, le Denza s’est doté d’un lest de 4 500 kg pour les essais sur deux roues afin d’éviter que le véhicule patine en tirant l’avion. Il a alors fallu retirer intégralement la banquette arrière pour accueillir cette charge.
Comment le véhicule a-t-il fait pour ne pas basculer sur le côté ?
D’autre part, des stabilisateurs ont été ajoutés sur chaque essieu pour compenser le retrait des deux roues. Ces béquilles n’enlèvent rien à la performance du véhicule, car supprimer deux roues du même côté aurait normalement déséquilibré le SUV. Or, ce n’est clairement pas le cas ici. Rappelons que le Denza Bao 5 adopte une configuration technique aussi complexe qu’originale.
Il combine trois moteurs électriques à un bloc essence de 1.5 l. Deux électromoteurs servent effectivement à faire avancer la voiture alors que le troisième sert de générateur. L’ensemble développe en cumulé 544 ch et 760 Nm de couple. Grâce à la batterie de 31,8 kWh, l’autonomie en mode électrique atteint les 90 km. Notons d’ailleurs que ce record a été uniquement réalisé en mode électrique.
